```{r ggplot_theme}

theme_kp <- function() {  # this for all the elements common across plots
  theme_bw() %+replace%
    theme(legend.position = "top",
          legend.key=element_blank(),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
          legend.key.size = unit(1.5, 'lines'),
          legend.background = element_rect(colour = NA),
          panel.border = element_rect(color="black",linewidth=1, fill = NA),
          
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 14),
          axis.text = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", color = "black"),
          
          # formatting for facets
          panel.background = element_blank(),
          strip.background = element_rect(colour="white", fill="white"), #facet formatting
          panel.grid = element_blank(),
          panel.spacing.x = unit(1, "lines"), #facet spacing for x axis
          panel.spacing.y = unit(1.5, "lines"), #facet spacing for x axis
          strip.text.x = element_text(size=16, face="bold"), #facet labels
          strip.text.y = element_text(size=16, face="bold", angle = 270) #facet labels
    )
}
theme_set(theme_kp())

pal_cores = rev(PNWColors::pnw_palette("Bay", 6))
```

## PNM


#### Equivalent radius - distributions

```{r pnm_radius_ridges, fig.height=20, fig.width=18}

# sysfonts::font_add_google("Playfair Display", "Playfair")
# sysfonts::font_add_google("Roboto", "Roboto")
# sysfonts::font_add_google("Andika", "Andika")
# showtext_auto()
# 

gg_radius_high = 
  xct_pnm_processed %>% 
  mutate(core_name = str_replace(core_name, "FOR_0", "Core ")) %>% 
  filter(water_treatment == "high water") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = EqRadius))+
  geom_density(aes(group = timepoint, fill = timepoint), color = "black", 
               alpha = 0.9, linewidth = 1)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = rev(PNWColors::pnw_palette("Sunset2", 33)))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("grey60", "lightblue", "#dd4124", "lightblue", "#dd4124", "lightblue", "#dd4124"),
                     breaks = c("T0", "F1", "T1", "F2", "T2", "F3", "T3"))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("grey60", "lightblue", "pink", "lightblue", "pink", "lightblue", "pink"),
                    breaks = c("T0", "F1", "T1", "F2", "T2", "F3", "T3"))+
  geom_label(data = xct_pnm_processed %>% distinct(core_name, timepoint, water_treatment) %>% filter(water_treatment == "high water") %>% 
               mutate(core_name = str_replace(core_name, "FOR_0", "Core ")),
             aes(label = paste("   ", timepoint, "   "), x = 2, y = 0.5, fill = timepoint),
             border.colour = NA, alpha = 0.8,
             face = "bold", size = 8,
             label.padding = unit(0.3, "lines"))+
  facet_grid(timepoint ~ core_name)+
  labs(x = "
       Equivalent Radius (mm)",
       title = "High Water Treatment
       ",
       y = "")+
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        panel.spacing.y = unit(-8, "lines"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 20, face = "bold"),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        axis.line.x = element_line(size = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        strip.text.y = element_blank(),
        strip.text.x = element_text(size = 20),
        plot.background = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 2)
  )
```

#### Coordination number

```{r pnm_coordination_raincloud, fig.height=10, fig.width=8}

xct_pnm_processed %>% 
  filter(core_name %in% c("FOR_01", "FOR_04")) %>% 
  mutate(core_name = str_replace(core_name, "FOR_0", "Core "),
         facet = paste0(water_treatment, " (", core_name, ")"),
         facet = factor(facet, levels = c("low water (Core 1)", "high water (Core 4)"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = timepoint, y = Coordination.Number, color = timepoint, group = timepoint, fill = timepoint)) +
  see::geom_violinhalf(width = 0.5, position = position_nudge(x = 0.3)#, color = "black"
                       )+
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 0.8)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("grey40", "lightblue", "pink", "lightblue", "pink", "lightblue", "pink"),
                     breaks = c("T0", "F1", "T1", "F2", "T2", "F3", "T3"))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("grey40", "lightblue", "pink", "lightblue", "pink", "lightblue", "pink"),
                    breaks = c("T0", "F1", "T1", "F2", "T2", "F3", "T3"))+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 20, linetype = "longdash")+
  labs(x = "", 
       y = "Pore Coordination Number")+
  facet_wrap(~facet, nrow = 2)+
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none")

```

```{r pnm_coordination_map, eval=FALSE}
# coordinations
print("FOR_O1: low water")

xct_pnm_processed %>% filter(core_name == "FOR_01" & 
                               Coordination.Number == 0  & 
                               grepl("T", timepoint) &
                               timepoint %in% c("T0", "T3")
                             ) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = X.Coord, y = Z.Coord, size = EqRadius))+
```

```{r pnm_pore_throats}
throats = 
  xct_pnm_processed %>% 
  dplyr::select(core_name, water_treatment, timepoint,
                Throat.ID, EqRadius.1, Pore.ID..1, Pore.ID..2)


pores =
  xct_pnm_processed %>% 
  dplyr::select(core_name, water_treatment, timepoint,
                Pore.ID, X.Coord, Z.Coord, Coordination.Number)

throats2 = 
  throats %>% 
  left_join(pores, by = c("core_name", "water_treatment", "timepoint", "Pore.ID..1" = "Pore.ID")) %>% 
  rename(x1 = X.Coord, 
         z1 = Z.Coord) %>% 
  left_join(pores, by = c("core_name", "water_treatment", "timepoint", "Pore.ID..2" = "Pore.ID")) %>% 
  rename(x2 = X.Coord, 
         z2 = Z.Coord) %>% 
  filter(Coordination.Number.x == 0 | Coordination.Number.x > 20 | Coordination.Number.y == 0 | Coordination.Number.y > 20)
```

```{r respiration_cumulative, fig.height=6, fig.width=6.5}
licor_cumulative = licor_cumulative %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = toupper(timepoint),
         timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = c("T0", "FTC1", "FTC2", "FTC3")),
         water_treatment = factor(water_treatment, levels = c("low water", "high water")))

```

```{r respiration_anova}
fit_anova <- function(dat) {
  
  l = lm(co2_umol_cum_g ~ water_treatment, data = dat)
  a = car::Anova(l, type = "III") 
  broom::tidy(a) %>% 
    filter(term == "water_treatment") %>% 
    dplyr::select(`p.value`) %>% 
    rename(pvalue = `p.value`)
}

# apply this to `licor_cumulative`
licor_anova = 
  licor_cumulative %>% 
  filter(core_name %in% c("FOR_07", "FOR_08", "FOR_09", "FOR_11", "FOR_12")) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  do(fit_anova(.))

licor_anova %>% knitr::kable()
```

```{r respiration_cumulative_gg, fig.height=6, fig.width=6}

licor_cumulative %>% 
  filter(core_name %in% c("FOR_07", "FOR_08", "FOR_09", "FOR_11", "FOR_12")) %>% 
  group_by(water_treatment, timepoint) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(mean = mean(co2_umol_cum_g),
                   se = sd(co2_umol_cum_g)/sqrt(n())) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = timepoint, y = mean, fill = (water_treatment)))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), color = "black", alpha = 0.8)+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.15)+
  geom_point(data = licor_cumulative %>% filter(core_name %in% c("FOR_07", "FOR_08", "FOR_09", "FOR_11", "FOR_12")),
             aes(y = co2_umol_cum_g),
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), size = 2.5
                 )+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c( "#CEA07E", "#155CA2"))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c( "#CEA07E", "#155CA2"))+
  labs(y = "Cumulative CO2 evolved, μmol",
       fill = "",
       x = "")+
  theme(legend.position = c(0.8, 0.8))

```

```{r biogeochemistry_summary}

chemistry_summary = 
  combined_chemistry %>% 
  filter(tube_type == "destructive cores") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(WEOC_ugg, TDN_ugg, MBC_ugg, MBN_ugg, TotalC_percent, TotalN_percent)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>% 
  group_by(water_treatment, ftc, name) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(
                   mean = mean(value),
                   sd = sd(value),
                   se = sd/sqrt(n())) %>% 
  mutate_if(is.numeric, round, 2) %>% 
  mutate(summary = paste(mean, "\u00b1", se)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-c(mean, sd, se)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(values_from = "summary") %>% 
  mutate(ftc = str_replace(ftc, "ftc", "T"),
         ftc = toupper(ftc)) %>% 
  arrange(desc(water_treatment), ftc)

chemistry_summary %>% 
  dplyr::select(water_treatment, ftc, 
                WEOC_ugg, TDN_ugg, MBC_ugg, MBN_ugg, TotalC_percent, TotalN_percent) %>% 
  knitr::kable()


```
